Name: (CP) Swoopier Hair Sebastian
Author: MicomiBite
Description:
I was inspired to give Seb's portrait a longer, swoopier haircut due to the fact that his overworld sprite always looked like it covered one eye to me. The mod changes his winter and beach portraits, too!

♡

(If there are any seasonal outfit mod authors who would like to adopt this mod's hairstyle, feel free to ask me about it. I may be willing to try working it into the portraits myself as well, but will not do so without explicit permission.)

♡

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drop into mods folder.
